children: Sterling edges higher after better-than-expected U.K. GDP data for July. Monthly GDP grew by 0.4% in July, stronger than the consensus forecast by economists in WSJ poll of flat growth. Annual GDP rose 1.6% in July, above the consensus forecast of 1.1% growth. Sterling rises 0.1% to $1.3522, up from around $1.3510 before the data. Euro falls 0.1% to 0.8582 pounds, down from 0.8591 beforehand. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
